scenes.title: beat-01
scenes.caption: A neural network is layers of neurons joined by weighted connections. A signal flows from the input layer, through the hidden layer, to the output.
scenes.narration: A neural network is layers of neurons joined by weighted connections. A signal flows from the input layer, through the hidden layer, to the output.

scenes.title: beat-02
scenes.caption: Training is a loop. The forward pass makes a prediction, we measure the loss, the backward pass finds the gradient, we update the weights, and then it repeats.
scenes.narration: Training is a loop. The forward pass makes a prediction, we measure the loss, the backward pass finds the gradient, we update the weights, and then it repeats.

scenes.title: beat-03
scenes.caption: As training goes on, the loss falls step by step, dropping quickly at first and then leveling off as the model settles near the minimum.
scenes.narration: As training goes on, the loss falls step by step, dropping quickly at first and then leveling off as the model settles near the minimum.

scenes.title: beat-04
scenes.caption: But watch the two curves. Training loss keeps dropping, yet validation loss turns and starts to rise. That growing gap is overfitting.
scenes.narration: But watch the two curves. Training loss keeps dropping, yet validation loss turns and starts to rise. That growing gap is overfitting.

scenes.title: beat-05
scenes.caption: It is a balance. Too simple and the model has high bias; too complex and high variance. We want the sweet spot between them.
scenes.narration: It is a balance. Too simple and the model has high bias; too complex and high variance. We want the sweet spot between them.
